;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Libyan Civil War (2014–present)|Second Libyan Civil War]]
**In a televised address, [[Field marshal (Libya)|Field Marshal]] [[Khalifa Haftar]] says his [[Libyan National Army]] is accepting a "popular mandate" to rule the country, seemingly declaring himself the ruler of [[Libya]] and dismissing the [[House of Representatives (Libya)|House of Representatives]]. An adviser to the [[Tripoli, Libya|Tripoli]]-based [[Government of National Accord]] says Haftar has exposed himself as an [[Authoritarianism|authoritarian]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-libya-security/libyas-eastern-leader-haftar-says-army-to-take-formal-control-idUSKCN2292RQ (Reuters)]

;Business and economy
*[[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic]], [[Coronavirus recession]]
**[[Offshore drilling]] contractor [[Diamond Offshore Drilling]] files for [[bankruptcy]] due to the [[2020 Russia–Saudi Arabia oil price war|oil price collapse]], following the reduction in oil demand during the global coronavirus pandemic. [https://www.wsj.com/articles/diamond-offshore-files-for-chapter-11-bankruptcy-11587925188 (''The Wall Street Journal'')]
**[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on aviation]] 
***[[Delta Air Lines]] announces it is suspending flights to several small-hub airports after losing [[United States dollar|$]]534 million in the first quarter of this year due to aviation restrictions caused by the coronavirus pandemic. [https://www.mlive.com/news/flint/2020/04/delta-air-lines-files-to-suspend-all-flights-in-flint-lansing-and-kalamazoo.html (MLive.com)]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**The number of worldwide cases of COVID-19 surpasses three million. The [[United States]] accounts for more than a third of the total cases. [https://reuters.com/article/uk-health-coronavirus-tally/global-coronavirus-cases-pass-3-million-as-lockdowns-begin-to-ease-idUKKCN2292AV (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in New Zealand]]
***[[Prime Minister of New Zealand|Prime Minister]] [[Jacinda Ardern]] reports no new community transmissions of [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] for the first time since the [[pandemic]] began, effectively eliminating the spread of the virus. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-52436658 (BBC News)]

;Law and crime
*[[Censorship in Vietnam]]
**A court in [[Vietnam]] sentences a man to one and a half years in jail for posting anti-[[government of Vietnam|government]] content on [[Facebook]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-vietnam-security-trial/vietnam-jails-facebook-user-over-anti-state-posts-idUSKCN2291AQ?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Joe Biden 2020 presidential campaign]]
**[[Speaker of the United States House of Representatives|Speaker of the House]] [[Nancy Pelosi]] officially [[List of Joe Biden 2020 presidential campaign endorsements|endorses]] former [[Vice President of the United States|Vice President]] [[Joe Biden]], the [[presumptive nominee]] in the [[2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries|Democratic Party primaries]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2020/04/27/us/politics/Pelosi-endorses-Biden.html (''The New York Times'')]
*The [[Ankara]] [[prosecutor]]'s office launches an investigation into a lawyers' organization which condemned the head of the [[Directorate of Religious Affairs]] for implying that [[homosexuality]] causes [[human immunodeficiency virus]] (HIV). The investigation is launched on the basis that the organization may have insulted [[Turkish people|Turks]]' [[religion in Turkey|religious]] values. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-turkey-rights-homosexuality/turkish-ruling-party-lawyers-clash-over-cleric-comments-on-homosexuality-idUSKCN2291LE?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Science and technology
*[[USS Nimitz UFO incident|USS ''Nimitz'' UFO incident]], [[USS Theodore Roosevelt UFO incidents|USS ''Theodore Roosevelt'' UFO incidents]]
**[[The Pentagon]] formally releases three videos of "[[Unidentified flying object|unidentified aerial phenomena]]" encountered by [[United States Navy]] pilots after determining the videos "do not reveal any sensitive capabilities or systems". The footage was previously leaked by [[Luis Elizondo]] in 2017. [https://edition.cnn.com/2020/04/27/politics/pentagon-ufo-videos/index.html (CNN)]
